findings.claim: The saveTelemetryDeduped method performs sequential database queries/writes in a loop without a transaction. If a query fails halfway, the ingestion run record is skipped, breaking observability and leaving the database in an inconsistent partial state.

The custom RegExp-based RSS parser uses dynamic regular expressions with unsafe non-greedy wildcards that are vulnerable to Regular Expression Denial of Service and silent failures on namespace-prefixed or self-closing tags.
INA client constructs a query range strictly bounded to the same-day UTC date, creating a data gap when run early in local Argentina time.
A failure in fetching a single INA series completely aborts the entire INA ingestion operation, discarding successful telemetry from other active stations.
The hydrology ingest in-memory concurrency lock is not safe across separate deployment nodes.
